name: Notepad3
author: Rizonetech (Pty) Ltd
summary: Notepad like text editor based on the Scintilla source code.
description: Notepad3 is a fast and light-weight Scintilla-based text editor with syntax highlighting. It has a small memory footprint, but is powerful enough to handle most programming jobs.
